description: This file defines a C# class ImplicitSubscriptionWithLongKeyGrain that implements an Orleans grain with implicit stream subscription based on a long key. It includes methods for activation and retrieving a stored value, and sets up stream subscription with logging.

classes.name: ImplicitSubscriptionWithLongKeyGrain
classes.description: An Orleans grain class that subscribes to a stream with a long key and logs received events.

methods.name: ImplicitSubscriptionWithLongKeyGrain
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the logger for the grain.

methods.name: OnActivateAsync
methods.description: Overrides the activation method to set up stream subscription and initialize the value.

methods.name: GetValue
methods.description: Returns the current stored value asynchronously.
